name: Summon Felsteed
summary: Strahad Farsan in Ratchet can teach you to summon a Felsteed. You are sent to him to learn the ability.

sections.title: A Visit to Ratchet
sections.body: You are sent to Ratchet to speak with Strahad Farsan. He can teach you the ability to summon a Felsteed, and you leave with his good wishes.

faq.q: Who teaches me to summon a Felsteed?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan in Ratchet can teach you the ability to summon a Felsteed.

faq.q: Where do I learn to summon a Felsteed?
faq.answer: You are directed to speak with Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
Strahad Farsan teaches the ability to summon a Felsteed.

angles.text: As a warlock, you are sent to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.
